Walk on the bottom: don't float up and keep the pickaxe, hammer, hoe or weapon in hand

<color=#c0c0c0>Under water you can dig with the pickaxe, build, level the ground, chop and fight as on land. To float up, turn the mode off.\nThe game lets you change the ground only by ±8 m from its original height, so you can't dig deeper than that.</color>
Enter the world to control time, weather and loot.
Skip world time to the chosen one (for everyone, like sleeping)
<color=#c0c0c0>Only the host can skip the real world time.</color>
Fix the chosen time only for me
The time of day runs as in the world again.
<color=#c0c0c0>«Skip» changes the real world time: a day passes, plants grow, ore finishes smelting.\n«Fix» changes only the lighting and day/night in your game, while the world lives on.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>Only the host can speed up world time.</color>
The whole game, like a speedhack

<color=#c0c0c0>World time speeds up furnaces, fermenters, smokers, crops and the day cycle, while you move as usual.\nSpeedhack speeds up everything in your game, you too. Large values load the processor.</color>
Show all weathers of the game

<color=#c0c0c0>Every game works out the weather itself, by the biome where its player stands. The chosen weather applies for you over the whole map\n(and in dungeons) until you click «Normal game weather».</color>
Send your friend the weather, the fixed time and the loot multiplier («Modifiers») if they have the mod too
Send the current settings to your friend
God mode (mobs, falls, cold, lava, poison)
Items don't break (weapons, tools, armor, shields, torches)
For the weapon in hand — up to ~{0:0} per hit.

<color=#c0c0c0>Works on weapon hits, arrows and spells. One hit is capped so that even with a backstab,\nstagger and the mob's weakness it stays below the game's 99 999 threshold, after which the mob becomes «cheated».
<color=#c0c0c0>All checkboxes and sliders of the menu are kept between game launches.</color>
